reason: Both put alert hygiene first, keep the weekly rotation, review every page at handoff, and give the on-call engineer authority to kill noisy alerts. B states the sprint-commitment point explicitly (0% sprint work on shift), while A only says to reserve part of the week. B also gives a concrete same-day first step and a reason for not changing the rotation. A adds auto-remediation, dedupe and grouping, and numeric targets to track, which are useful but don't change the first thing to fix. B is slightly better aligned with the key points.
